title: Disjoint initial and remaining coordinates
statement: For any two indices $b,s\in\{0,1,2\}$, take the three coordinates of the $b$th block in a nine-coordinate array, indexed by $j\in\{0,1,2\}$. The singleton consisting of the coordinate indexed by $s$ is disjoint from the set of the other two coordinates in that block.
